command: cd validation && uv run python pkg2/heater_layers.py
method: compliance bounds of steady conduction (monotonicity in k; Dirichlet and complementary principles with exact cosine-series fields of layered models as trials; own derivation)

targets.definition: mean heater temperature rise at 1 mW: Dirichlet bound with the all-Si-core-layer field as trial
targets.locator: validation/pkg2/heater_layers.py improved(), core_energies(), mean_rise(), z_surface(); eval/expected/PK-10.json (3D quarter model), PK-11.json (2D section)
